limitations: No scheme-theoretic decomposition of the Jacobian ideal.
n=3,4 and characteristic two excluded from theorem.
scientific_integrity: The rank-stratum classification is proved for algebraically closed fields of characteristic not 2 and n at least 5. Exact test cases corroborate but cannot establish generality. Originality remains qualified by potential unindexed coordinate-section equivalences. No claim is made about the full Jacobian scheme or independent review.
title: Two transverse quadric types on the hollow symmetric determinant
